# Spider evaluation scripts (vendored)

`evaluation.py` and `process_sql.py` are copied from the [Spider](https://github.com/taoyds/spider) repository (Yale LILY / Yu et al., 2018) for **exact set match (EM)** scoring.

They are **not** part of the RAID-SQL MIT-licensed original code. Use under Spider’s upstream licence / academic terms. Prefer citing:

Yu et al., “Spider: A Large-Scale Human-Labeled Dataset for Complex and Cross-Domain Semantic Parsing and Text-to-SQL Task,” EMNLP 2018.

Source files: https://github.com/taoyds/spider (`evaluation.py`, `process_sql.py`).
